title: RMB | Ultra-trail Cape Town 2025 — ITRA results
claims: At the 2025 ULTRA-TRAIL 100 KM the first three men were Jeff Mogavero in 11:04:53, Dmitry Mityaev in 11:05:24 and Matthew Healy in 11:11:26.
At the 2025 UTCT 100 MILE the winner was Douglas Pickard in 21:49:11.
The 2025 ULTRA-TRAIL 100 KM used the same 99.85 km, +5,085 m, 26-hour listing as 2026.
At the 2025 ULTRA-TRAIL 100 KM the first woman was Sunmaya Budha (Nepal) in 12:25:55, eighth overall.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 复读 ITRA 2025 届 100K 结果页（102584）与 100M 结果页（102583）；100K 页码用于男子前三与女子第一，100M 完整前三另存 route-utct-2025-100m-results。
